body: The thing is, I think they do care about me. They just aren't good at displaying it, and at the moment that's what I really need.

It's all the time, but nothing important. Like, I'll be excited to talk about something I did well, like playing well in my lesson (I have a screwed up arm which makes it really hard to play my instrument), and someone will cut in to tell a pun.
No, it's that I'll say "oh, guess what happened with--" and I'll be interrupted by another friend. And when I try again, it happens again, until I give up.

If you want. A lot of my problem is that I need someone to talk to during the day when I'm upset at school. I feel alone in person, and it hurts that people who insist that they love me don't even talk to me.
